name: Sintra

one_liner.value: Build and scale your business with AI employees - smart AI workers designed to work around the clock.
also_acceptable: Finally, AI that knows you and your business. Now you really can do it all. Your Sintra AI Employees support you in the day-to-day of running a business.
one_liner.note: The reading tool returned only the opening of the meta description.

categories.quote: Sintra automates your socials, inbox, content, and business operations without adding extra headcount or management overhead.

categories.note: The last four quotes are task labels on the AI-employee role cards (SEO, customer support, copywriter, e-commerce roles), not sentences.

target_user.note: 'enterprise' is a section heading on the orchestration page (next to 'For startups' and 'For SMBs'); the main audience named across the site is business owners and entrepreneurs.

tasks.note: 'Write copy' and 'Optimize pages' are role-card task labels.

can_execute.quote: Your email marketer uses Gmail to send campaigns; your data analyst pulls from Google Analytics for reports.
can_execute.note: FAQ answer on the integrations page, confirmed on a second read. Same page: 'Sintra integrations are read-write only for the tasks your specialists need.'

multi_agent.quote: Give the orchestrator a goal and it coordinates your agents through these steps.
multi_agent.note: Body of the orchestration page, confirmed on a second read; its FAQ adds 'Sintra orchestrates its helpers to do this.' The homepage says 'One team with different AI agents as employees.'

integrations.note: First 25 of the 29 names in the integrations-page grid, in page order; the remaining four and Xero (body text only) are in 'overflow'. On the homepage the integration logos are images only, with names visible just in file names.

pricing.quote: We're not able to offer free trials at this time
pricing.note: No free plan is listed and the site says there are no free trials (there is a '14-day money-back guarantee'). Yearly plan '$15.60 /mo' (shown with '$52' and 'Save 70%'); quarterly '$23.60 /mo'; monthly '$48.50 /mo' (shown with '$97').

hq_location.note: No address on the pages read; footers show 'Copyright © 2026 PlayOS, Inc. All rights reserved'.

hq_external.quote: The team’s story began in 2018 in a garage in Vilnius, Lithuania
hq_external.note: Weaker than the other hq_external entries: the article (10 June 2025) calls Sintra a Lithuanian startup 'proudly built in Lithuania' but does not use the word headquarters. https://builtin.com/company/sintra lists offices in the United States and Lithuania without naming a headquarters, and the legal entity on the site is PlayOS, Inc.

notes: Homepage integration names exist only as logo images. Prices are shown as discounts against list prices, which invites a wrong starting price.
